current_app_change: Source citation wrapper: explicit publication_url selects source-dataset, publication/methods and data-licence labels; existing atlas/MRI template fallback unchanged.
visual_review: Every one of the36 new actual source-dialog/native-viewer PNG captures across both subjects was directly opened and inspected. Native-size source dialogs intentionally show a scrollable viewport portion; full original natural extents and exact source bytes were separately checked by the actual browser harness. Native canvas captures show the existing54-object source view on both routes and widths; all54 draw calls and decoded hashes are independently retained in the browser output. This is compatibility, not anatomy/clinical approval.

source_case_citation_wrapper_evidence.actual_change_scope: Source citation wrapper: explicit publication_url selects source-dataset, publication/methods and data-licence labels; existing atlas/MRI template fallback unchanged.

historical_capture_scope_limit: The preserved original cervical record lists 16 capture filenames not present in this checkout, with no matching SHA-256 among retained cervical PNGs. Its historical observations are preserved as recorded, not independently reverified from those absent captures. Previous and current compatibility captures are all present and byte-checked; neither is represented as replacement historical evidence.
